answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37487 Country: India Title: While offering salah with jamah, is it necessary for the muqtadi to say "Assalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullah" with the imam after completing the tashahhu Question: While offering salah with jamah, is it necessary for the muqtadi to say "Assalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullah" with the imam after completing the tashahhud? Answer ID: 37487 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 537/537/M=1433) Yes, it is wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
